commands.release: npx --no-install playwright test tests/representative-finder.spec.mjs tests/official-contact.spec.mjs tests/local-record-filter.spec.mjs tests/frontend-pass-a.spec.mjs tests/zip-lookup-state.spec.mjs tests/editorial-cutover.spec.mjs tests/ir-presentation.spec.mjs tests/production-evidence-integration.spec.mjs tests/public-record-integrity.spec.mjs tests/record-card.spec.mjs tests/record-card-release.spec.mjs tests/education79-card-compatibility.spec.mjs --workers=2 --retries=0 --forbid-only --trace=retain-on-failure --reporter=line,json

acceptance.held_search: ZIP/name at 320/390/768/1440: initial loading; guidance at 8 seconds, still pending after another 60 seconds; exactly one GET despite same-turn duplicate submits; eventual success removes guidance and Cancel.
acceptance.cancellation: Actual browser fetch rejects with AbortError for ZIP/name Cancel and switch Close/history Back. Inputs and URL/history are retained; explicit same-query resubmit issues exactly one new GET.
acceptance.stale_callbacks: Transport ignoring abort permits forced late success/network/503 errors; sequence guards reject them after superseding/invalid search, Cancel/resubmit, Close, selection, remount and history. Forced obsolete timer callback is inert during cancelled, newer loading and newer ready states.
acceptance.semantics: All established ZIP-state qualifications, 404 versus server errors, empty name versus network failure, explicit selection and literal official link activation tests pass.
acceptance.keyboard: Tab reaches Cancel with visible outline at 320/390/768/1440; Enter cancels and returns focus to the active input; existing qualified-selection keyboard tests pass without horizontal overflow.

limitations: Controlled local production-build tests, not a claim about a live incident or the cause of elapsed time.
Browser ARIA/keyboard assertions do not constitute assistive-technology or physical-device testing.
Fresh exact-head hosted CI is reported by the draft PR checks after push.
